name: Summarize Documents
description: Summarize documents to their main and key points, or turn a PDF into structured notes with an outline, key terms, numbers and dates, each citing its page.
abilities: Reads the whole document before summarizing, or says when it only had passages
Leads with the main point, then the key points with their page or section
Keeps names, numbers and dates exactly as written
Summarizes several documents one by one, then what they share
Reads the whole PDF in order, page by page, without skipping
Writes a summary, an outline that follows the document, key terms, numbers and dates
Cites the page for every point
Saves the notes as Markdown or a Word document when you ask
permissions: Reads files you attach, files in your workspace and passages Knowledge Search finds
Uses the Documents plugin to read the PDF, and OCR for scanned pages if you agree

changes.notes: Merged with PDF to Structured Notes, which is part of this skill now.
